svg.title: Proof. The identities ti = ∑︁m k=i (︁k i )︁(︁m i )︁−1(︁m k )︁tk(1 −t)m−k and their s counterparts give the stated coefficients. The product Bernstein basis is nonnegative and sums to one on the unit square, so the polynomial is a convex combination of its coefficients. Subdivision covers the original rectangle. Attainment supplies the reverse inequality whenever the two bounds coincide.
